author: dekorher alçıpan (dekorher)
developer_reply: Hi. We didn't expect widgets to be some important for our users. As our development team is very small, we couldn't develop all the features we wanted. But we keep working on the app and releasing new features every single month. The good news is that we have scheduled Widgets development for next month.
